families.name: Ahuizotl
families.lore: A being crafted by the power of arcane, this wolf shaped familiar is one of the first spells of conjuration a young mage learns in his training, teaching them how to cast a spell that will persist without the mage’s concentration. The Ahuizotl you encounter here are chaotic of form and violent of nature, attacking any who draw near. The sight of an Ahuizotl wandering the wilds and in this number is unusual.

families.name: Ancient Earth Golem
families.lore: Some Earth Golems retain more of their ancient glory than others, the stone of their bodies standing firm against the ravages of time. These Ancient Earth Golems retain more of the magic of their creation, wielding power over the wind itself.

families.name: Bone Fiend
families.lore: In the centuries since the Empire embraced undeath, experimentation in the arcane and the stolen divine power of the Emperor himself has run rampant. The Bone Fiends are the latest of the Undead Empire’s terrible accomplishments, a fusing of animated bone and Draal chitin, this creation eschews what little resemblance to humanity the Undead Empire’s previous creations could claim.

families.name: Dark Fiend
families.lore: The Bone Fiends were brought by the Imperial Necromancers in their expedition to the temple as a test of their power and efficiency, and like the necromancers that commanded them they too were corrupted by the void. An aberration of an abomination.

families.name: Dire Wolf
families.lore: The wolves of the valley have lived in harmony with man for many ages, both thriving under the watchful eye of Eterra as the ravenous Draal were driven underground. Things are different now, game is thin for man and wolf alike, leaving the wolves with little choice but to prey on their one time friends.

families.name: Draal Grub
families.lore: The juvenile form of the insectoid scourge known as the Draal, these grubs know nothing but hunger from the moment they hatch within their host.

families.name: Draal Queen
families.lore: One of the last of the Draal Queens, her meager brood resides in a fetid swamp. The rise of the undead has driven away many of the humans and other wildlife of the region, giving the Draal an opportunity to regrow their numbers and begin to establish a true hive.

families.name: Drowned Mage
families.lore: This mage lived in the village not far from here, where he taught himself the arcane arts from dusty tomes, his eccentric interests earning him a lonely childhood. As he became a man, he earned the respect of the town, defending it from the odd bandit and troll with his magic, he promised his kin that he would continue to protect them as the Undead Empire encroaching closer and closer to their borders. His cowardice made him a liar. As he fled to the caves beyond the town, regret and sorrow consumed his mind, his mouth compulsively reciting the spell that always gave him comfort in his youth, the spell for summoning an Ahuizotl.

families.name: Earth Golem
families.lore: The oldest of the golems, the Earth Golems served Eterra back in the ancient times when she was the only being that claimed the mantle of godhood, all other golems carved in their image. The golems of this age are a shadow of the ancient Earth Golems, lost and rageful since the voice of their goddess left the world.

families.name: Fire Golem
families.lore: These golems once dwelled below the eastern mountains, tending to the molten flames deep within at the command of Rahyeh before his eyes grew disdainful of the fire below. Once his attentions became focused on his eagles of war and conquest of his siblings, the Fire Golems were left to wander the caverns of the world, burning with fire forgotten.

families.name: Ice Golem
families.lore: Once servants of the northern god Heorot, the ice golems of this era are scattered and dwell deep in caves and high in the mountains.The chill of the remote places they are drawn to remind them an older time where they roamed the north, guiding the lost back to Heorot’s great herd. The Ice Golems that wander to the valley are said to be a fraction of the size of the titans that rest far away beneath the aurora.

families.name: Imperial Necromancer
families.lore: A rank and file officer of the Undead Empire, the Imperial Necromancer’s have accepted more than just the Emperor’s gift of immortality, but also a fragment of his dark power. These necromancers raise and command swarms of undead bound to their will, carrying out the Emperor’s will in his crusade to convert the living and unite humanity.

families.name: Infested Silvan Wolf
families.lore: As simple as the minds of the Draal insects are, they share a racial memory. They remember a time when humans with their spears and green wreathed wolves shattered the Great Hive and usurped their world. To see one of their ancient enemies reduced to being a host for their squirming young is a sight all Draal hunger for.

families.name: Moss Troll
families.lore: One of the fiercest of wild creatures, Moss Trolls were once driven to the outskirts of the valley, hiding in caves and mountainpasses. The strifes that have plagued the land have made them bold, their moss covered forms creeping ever closer to human settlements, snatching away livestock and whatever humans are foolish enough to cross their path.

families.name: Silvan Wolf
families.lore: The connection between wolves and man was once much stronger than it is now. Druids of the ancient tribes used to practice the art of shapeshifting and would often take the form of great wolves in order to commune with the world of beasts, some in fact found they prefered this life and never returned.

families.name: Spectral Guard
families.lore: The Empire has learned the art of summoning the spirits of the dead and binding them to a necromancer’s command, the need for a stable physical body no longer necessary. These Spectral Guards lack any of the illusion of free will that a true citizen of the Undead Empire would have, their chained souls forced to obey any command of the necromancer who summoned them.

families.name: Stalagma
families.lore: These lava elementals claim no allegiance to god or man, having formed themselves from the raw arcane and the hiding in the world only to lash out at passersby. Some of these creatures hide deep in caverns, disguising themselves as stalagmites until someone draws close upon which they reveal themselves, gleefully burning their prey to cinders.

families.name: Thunder Golem
families.lore: The western seas once raged with storms, crackling with lightning and bellowing thunder, the hallmark of the sea god Lagon’s design. The seas are quiet now, the memory of their majestic fury surviving in the worn stone of wandering Thunder Golems.

families.name: Void Touched Necromancer
families.lore: These Imperial Necromancers were part of the regiment sent to locate the temple where a powerful relic is said to be stored, and it seems that they found something else. All loyalty to the Emperor has been lost in the haze of the void, the only desire left in their corrupted mind that of spreading the void and consuming existence.
